1aec260d9b4c924c3281.en: Position words tell us where things are.

75cf8549e29bc36b3730.en: The car is between the ball and the book.
75cf8549e29bc36b3730.id: Mobil ada di antara (between) bola dan buku.

dd5d6e2ea01b80eee57f.en: The ball is to the left of the car. The book is to the right of the car.
dd5d6e2ea01b80eee57f.id: Bola ada di sebelah kiri (left) mobil. Buku ada di sebelah kanan (right) mobil.

a0ca8b95531855f74d5e.en: Above means higher up. Below means lower down.
a0ca8b95531855f74d5e.id: Above berarti di atas, lebih tinggi. Below berarti di bawah, lebih rendah.

6c7c6485f13593cab495.en: The bag is in the middle, so it is between the cup and the hat.
6c7c6485f13593cab495.id: Tas (bag) ada di tengah, jadi tas itu ada di antara cangkir (cup) dan topi (hat).

c47cc27952df6ecad933.en: B is lower down than P, in the same column, so B is below P.
c47cc27952df6ecad933.id: B lebih rendah daripada P, di kolom yang sama, jadi B ada di bawah (below) P.

9abde1c9862547b2f331.en: Below and above are opposites. What is above something has that thing below it.
9abde1c9862547b2f331.id: Below (di bawah) dan above (di atas) saling berlawanan. Kalau sesuatu ada di atas benda lain, benda lain itu ada di bawahnya.

e712024c223e55a3f160.en: On top means above. The ball is above the box.
e712024c223e55a3f160.id: On top berarti di atas (above). Bola ada di atas kotak.

80ef9a13dc115513ff47.en: Between means in the middle of two things. The middle child has one on each side.
80ef9a13dc115513ff47.id: Between (di antara) berarti di tengah dua benda. Anak yang di tengah punya satu anak di setiap sisinya.
